doc: Structure-tensor coherence: gaussian_filter(patch, 1.0) (default mode reflect, truncate 4.0; axis 0 then axis 1; the output keeps the input dtype), np.gradient (central differences inside, one-sided at the borders), products smoothed by gaussian_filter(sigma), coherence sqrt((jxx - jyy)^2 + 4 jxy^2) / (jxx + jyy) weighted by the trace. The same noise as a float32 patch: scipy rounds to float32 after each of the two passes of every gaussian_filter and np.gradient / the products stay float32, so the result differs from the float64 one by 8.2e-9 (relative); the golden float32 tolerance.
